services.title: Parcel delivery
services.description: Send packages, gifts, clothing, electronics and everyday goods with a delivery arrangement suited to the contents and destination.
services.details: Relay arranges parcel movements for individuals and businesses, from a single gift to multiple customer packages. Share the packed size, weight and contents so operations can confirm handling, route and delivery arrangements.
prepare: Package count, packed dimensions and weight
An accurate description of the contents and any fragile or valuable items
Collection and delivery addresses with usable contact details
services.note: Some products need an acceptance review. Packaging, declared value and delivery timing should be agreed before handover.
services.alt: Kraft-wrapped gift parcel and plain packages on a counter

services.title: Document delivery
services.description: Arrange careful transport for contracts, certificates, legal paperwork, business letters and other documents.
services.details: Use document delivery when paperwork needs a clear handover between people, offices or organisations. Protective envelopes and recipient instructions help keep the delivery organised. Tell operations if originals, a named recipient or a particular acknowledgment are required.
prepare: Envelope count and appropriate protective packaging
Whether the recipient must be a named person or an authorised office contact
Any required handover acknowledgment and agreed timing
services.note: Keep unnecessary confidential information out of public enquiry notes. Discuss sensitive or irreplaceable originals through your known shipping contact.
services.alt: Hands placing an envelope into a protective document pouch

services.title: Same-day delivery
services.description: Get eligible local items collected and delivered on the same day, with route and cut-off arrangements confirmed before booking.
services.details: Relay offers same-day arrangements for local movements where the route, readiness and collection time support completion that day. Provide both locations and the required handover time so operations can confirm the service before dispatch.
prepare: Collection and destination locations
The time the item will be ready and the required delivery time
Recipient availability and any access restrictions
services.note: Same-day eligibility, collection cut-offs, operating hours and any service commitment must be confirmed for the particular booking; this is not a universal same-day guarantee.
services.alt: Unbranded local delivery van travelling through a city

services.title: Express delivery
services.description: Choose priority handling for urgent documents or parcels within a delivery window agreed for the route.
services.details: Express delivery puts urgency at the centre of the service discussion. Operations reviews the contents, distance, readiness and recipient requirements before confirming the applicable priority arrangement and expected timing.
prepare: The specific deadline and why the movement is time-sensitive
Cargo description, packed size and weight
A reachable sender and recipient throughout the delivery window
services.note: Do not assume a fixed number of hours or automatic priority from submitting a quote. Confirm the accepted service, charges and timing with operations.
services.alt: Small parcel beside an analog clock at a dispatch counter

services.title: Door-to-door delivery
services.description: Arrange collection from the sender’s address and delivery to the recipient’s address, with access and handover details agreed.
services.details: A door-to-door arrangement connects collection and final delivery in one coordinated movement. Provide complete addresses rather than landmarks alone, and explain building access, loading requirements or recipient instructions in advance.
prepare: Complete pickup and delivery addresses
Building, gate, parking or loading access requirements
Sender and recipient contacts and availability
services.note: Confirm whether any special access, lifting, remote-location or additional-handling charges apply. A quote request does not itself schedule collection.
services.alt: Courier handing a plain parcel to a customer at a home doorway

services.title: Interstate delivery
services.description: Move parcels and goods between cities or states with collection, onward movement and delivery arrangements reviewed together.
services.details: Relay coordinates interstate movements for personal shipments and commercial goods. Tell operations the origin and destination cities, cargo details and preferred timing so the relevant road and onward-delivery arrangements can be confirmed.
prepare: Origin and destination cities or states
Piece count, packed dimensions and total weight
Collection readiness and delivery-site requirements
services.note: Transit estimates depend on the agreed route, handling and conditions. Ask what collection and final delivery are included in the confirmed quotation.
services.alt: Freight vehicle travelling between regions on a divided highway

services.title: International shipping
services.description: Send documents and parcels across borders with coordinated shipping arrangements and associated document preparation.
services.details: Relay arranges international movements with the applicable transport and carrier options reviewed for the goods and destination. Confirm acceptance, documentation, importer responsibilities and the expected charging arrangement before dispatch.
prepare: Origin, destination and an accurate description of every type of goods
Packed dimensions, weights, declared values and currency
Recipient or importer details and applicable supporting documents
services.note: Customs requirements and duties depend on the shipment and destination. A partner carrier is only part of a shipment when confirmed by operations; no automatic FedEx integration is implied.
services.alt: Coastal cargo terminal and an aircraft in the distance

services.title: E-commerce delivery
services.description: Deliver orders from online shops, social media vendors and other digital businesses to their customers.
services.details: Give your customers a clearer handover by preparing accurate order, contact and package information. Relay arranges delivery for online sellers, with the agreed service, recipient instructions and any return requirements confirmed through operations.
prepare: Order volumes, package sizes and destination areas
Customer contact details through an agreed private channel
Delivery priorities, return instructions and any requested COD arrangement
services.note: The current website does not automatically import online-store orders or synchronise inventory. Discuss the operational handover process with your Relay contact.
services.alt: Online seller preparing clothing orders in plain cartons

services.title: Pickup services
services.description: Have parcels, goods or documents collected from a home, office, shop or warehouse.
services.details: Relay offers collection arrangements for ready-to-move items. Share the collection location, package details and readiness window so operations can confirm the appropriate pickup and onward transport.
prepare: Collection address and the person handing over the shipment
Cargo readiness, piece count and packed measurements
Parking, loading, lifting or other access requirements
services.note: Pickups must be confirmed with operations. Completing an enquiry form or checklist does not automatically assign a rider, vehicle or collection slot.
services.alt: A courier scanning a parcel during collection at a business

services.title: Dispatch rider services
services.description: Use motorcycle-based delivery arrangements for suitable small parcels, paperwork and urgent local orders.
services.details: Dispatch rider services support local movements where the item’s size, weight and handling needs suit motorcycle transport. Tell operations about fragile, liquid, food or other special-care contents before a collection is agreed.
prepare: Local pickup and delivery locations
Packed dimensions, weight and the nature of the contents
Required timing and reachable handover contacts
services.note: Motorcycle suitability and acceptance are reviewed for the actual item. Food or other sensitive goods need agreed packaging and handling arrangements rather than an assumption of temperature control.
services.alt: Helmeted motorcycle courier beside an unbranded delivery bike

services.title: Cash on delivery (COD)
services.description: Arrange payment collection from the recipient at delivery and remittance to the seller under agreed terms.
services.details: Relay offers COD arrangements for eligible merchant deliveries. Confirm the amount to collect, permitted payment method, collection charges, reconciliation process and remittance schedule with operations before goods are dispatched.
prepare: The seller, order reference and exact amount and currency to collect
Recipient details and instructions if payment is refused or incomplete
Agreed remittance details, reconciliation requirements and applicable terms
services.note: COD is an operational arrangement, not the website’s bank-transfer reference form. The current site does not automatically collect, settle or reconcile COD funds.

services.title: Warehousing and storage
services.description: Store goods temporarily before dispatch or delivery under an agreed storage and release arrangement.
services.details: Relay offers storage arrangements to support goods awaiting distribution or onward movement. Discuss the goods, expected duration, space requirements and release instructions so operations can confirm the suitable arrangement and terms.
prepare: Goods description, quantities, packed sizes and storage duration
Any environmental, security or handling requirements
Receiving, release and inventory-record requirements
services.note: Location, capacity, storage conditions, access, liability and charges require confirmation. This website is not a warehouse inventory management system.

services.title: Freight and bulk cargo delivery
services.description: Move large, heavy or high-volume shipments using a vehicle and handling arrangement suited to the load.
services.details: Relay arranges bulk and freight movements for loose pieces, pallets, crates and other cargo formats. Accurate piece-level measurements help operations plan the transport, loading and unloading requirements.
prepare: Dimensions and weights for each piece, not only a shipment total
Whether the cargo is palletised, stackable or needs special securing
Loading equipment, vehicle access and destination handling requirements
services.note: Confirm the vehicle, route, cargo acceptance and handling responsibilities before loading. Specialist equipment and additional handling are not assumed to be included in every quotation.

services.title: Shipment tracking
services.description: Follow the status, published location milestones and latest estimate for a registered Relay shipment.
services.details: Customers can use a Relay reference or private tracking link without creating an account. Operations publishes shipment milestones and may approve location pins, route endpoints and photographs for the customer view.
prepare: Your Relay reference or the private link provided by your shipping contact
The latest event time and note when asking about an update
A known contact channel if an estimate has passed or an update needs explanation
services.note: Tracking locations are manually recorded, not continuous GPS. Only approved map information appears publicly, and an estimated arrival is not a guaranteed delivery appointment.

services.title: Proof of delivery
services.description: Request an appropriate delivery confirmation, such as a signature, photograph or recipient acknowledgment, for the agreed service.
services.details: Relay offers delivery-confirmation arrangements to support a clear handover record. Agree the evidence needed before dispatch, including any named-recipient requirement, photographic confirmation or signature arrangement.
prepare: The type of delivery confirmation required
Any named recipient or authorised substitute instructions
Who may receive the confirmation and through which private channel
services.note: A tracking status or printable shipment summary is not automatically signed proof of delivery. The current website does not capture electronic recipient signatures; evidence is arranged through operations and should protect personal information.

services.title: Returns and reverse logistics
services.description: Collect returned, exchanged or rejected goods and coordinate transport back to the seller or warehouse.
services.details: Relay arranges reverse movements when a seller or receiving party has agreed the return. Confirm the pickup, return destination, item condition and any original order references before the goods move.
prepare: Return authorisation or the responsible seller contact
Item details, condition and suitable return packaging
Collection address, return destination and who pays the charges
services.note: A return is not an automatic refund. The current website does not issue return labels or approve refunds; international returns may also need specific customs arrangements.

services.title: Fulfilment services
services.description: Coordinate inventory handling, order packaging, shipment processing and dispatch for your business.
services.details: Relay offers fulfilment arrangements to help businesses connect stored goods with outgoing customer orders. Discuss receiving, stock records, order handover, packing specifications and dispatch priorities with the operations team.
prepare: Product range, quantities and expected order frequency
Packing standards, order information and stock-control expectations
Storage, dispatch, reporting and return-handling requirements
services.note: The operational scope and charges must be agreed. The current website does not include a customer inventory portal or automatic ecommerce integration.

services.title: Specialized delivery
services.description: Arrange suitable handling for fragile, valuable or temperature-sensitive goods after a cargo-specific review.
services.details: Specialised shipments need a conversation about the product rather than only its weight. Relay reviews the proposed movement, packaging, handling conditions and relevant restrictions before confirming the arrangement.
prepare: Product identity, value, fragility and any required environmental conditions
Packaging, documentation and handling instructions
Route, timing, acceptance and any requested protection arrangements
services.note: Do not assume temperature-controlled equipment, dangerous-goods acceptance or insurance from this listing alone. Confirm the exact conditions, exclusions and service arrangement before dispatch.

services.title: Packaging services
services.description: Arrange boxes, envelopes, protective wrapping and packaging assistance suited to the shipment.
services.details: Relay offers packaging support for customers who need suitable materials or help preparing goods for transport. Describe the items, their packed or unpacked dimensions and any fragile surfaces so the appropriate approach can be discussed.
prepare: Item type, dimensions, weight and fragility
Whether packaging materials, packing assistance or both are needed
Any handling, marking or carrier requirements already confirmed
services.note: Materials, professional packing scope, charges and any special-care conditions must be agreed. A fragile label cannot replace adequate protection.

services.title: Business-to-business (B2B) delivery
services.description: Move supplies, stock, documents and materials between offices, retailers, companies and warehouses.
services.details: Relay supports business movements where reliable handover information matters at both ends. Share the receiving-site process, purchase or dispatch references and loading requirements to help operations coordinate the delivery.
prepare: Collection and receiving-business details
Stock or document references and piece-level cargo information
Receiving hours, booking requirements and access restrictions
services.note: A delivery booking should specify who can receive the goods and which acknowledgments are required. Site appointments and special handling need confirmation.

services.title: Delivery notifications
services.description: Arrange shipment communication by SMS, email or phone according to the agreed service and contact preferences.
services.details: Relay offers communication arrangements to keep the relevant people informed about a delivery. Confirm the recipients, preferred channel and which updates are expected as part of the service.
prepare: Authorised contact details and preferred communication channels
The updates your sender, recipient or business team needs
Any privacy or escalation requirements
services.note: The current website publishes tracking milestones but does not automatically send SMS or email notifications. Notification arrangements are managed through operations; do not infer an automatic alert from submitting a quote.

services.title: Scheduled and recurring deliveries
services.description: Plan agreed delivery windows or repeat movements around your household or business needs.
services.details: Relay offers scheduled arrangements for one-off movements and recurring delivery needs. Share the frequency, usual locations, cargo profile and any exceptions so operations can review a workable schedule.
prepare: Preferred dates, frequency and collection or delivery windows
Typical item counts, dimensions, weights and route variations
Contacts, access requirements and arrangements for changes
services.note: Schedules, capacity, cut-offs and change terms must be confirmed. The current website does not automatically reserve calendar slots or create recurring bookings.

services.title: Bulk delivery contracts
services.description: Discuss a structured delivery arrangement for repeat business volumes, routes and service requirements.
services.details: Relay offers business delivery contracts where shipment volumes and requirements can be reviewed together. Provide a realistic view of frequency, destination areas, handling needs and reporting expectations to support the discussion.
prepare: Expected shipment volumes and seasonal changes
Common destinations, parcel profiles and delivery priorities
Reconciliation, communication, return and reporting requirements
services.note: Rates, minimums, service levels and commercial terms are agreed individually. This page does not establish discounted pricing, account credit or a signed contract.

services.title: Dedicated vehicles or riders
services.description: Arrange dedicated transport resources for corporate delivery needs under an agreed operational scope.
services.details: Relay offers dedicated rider or vehicle arrangements for organisations with a defined delivery pattern. Discuss the route coverage, operating windows, load profile and supervision requirements before capacity is assigned.
prepare: Required rider or vehicle type and operating hours
Typical loads, routes, delivery frequency and access needs
Reporting contacts, safety requirements and contract duration
services.note: The allocation, availability, operating area and terms require confirmation. This website does not automatically assign or show live positions of dedicated riders or vehicles.

services.title: Delivery insurance or declared-value coverage
services.description: Ask for available shipment-protection or declared-value arrangements and review the applicable terms before dispatch.
services.details: Relay offers protection arrangements for eligible shipments. Discuss the goods, value, route and requested protection with operations, and review the relevant insurer or carrier terms where applicable before relying on coverage.
prepare: Accurate cargo description, value and supporting evidence
The proposed route, packaging and handling requirements
Required protection, exclusions and the applicable claims procedure
services.note: Declaring a value does not by itself establish insurance. Coverage, limits, exclusions, provider, charges and effective terms must be confirmed; this website does not issue an insurance policy.

services.title: Customs documentation assistance
services.description: Get help preparing the shipment information and document questions associated with international movements.
services.details: Relay offers documentation assistance to help organise accurate cargo descriptions, values, party details and supporting paperwork for review. Requirements vary with the goods, transaction and countries involved.
prepare: Commercial or transaction details, descriptions, quantities and values
Origin information and sender, recipient or importer details
Any permits, product certificates or broker instructions required for review
services.note: Assistance is not a promise of customs release or a declaration filing. Confirm responsibility for classification, official submissions, duties, taxes and broker arrangements.

services.title: Collection from multiple locations
services.description: Coordinate goods collected from several addresses into an agreed delivery or onward-distribution plan.
services.details: Relay offers multi-location collection arrangements for customers and businesses managing several pickup points. Share a clear stop list, cargo profile and readiness window for each location so the route and consolidation needs can be reviewed.
prepare: All collection addresses and contacts through a private channel
Item counts, measurements and readiness at each stop
The final destination, consolidation requirements and delivery priorities
services.note: Route order, collection windows, capacity and charges require confirmation. Adding a location to an enquiry does not automatically schedule a stop.
